cards.card_text: Then the LORD lays out the Feast of Unleavened Bread: seven days with no leaven anywhere in the house, a sacred assembly on the first day and the seventh, and no work on those days except making the meals.
cards.verse_text: On the first day you are to remove the leaven from your houses.

cards.card_text: It’s all moving so fast, the people grab their dough before it’s leavened.
cards.verse_text: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, carrying it on their shoulders in kneading bowls wrapped in clothing.

cards.card_text: Then Moses adds a rule: "And nothing leavened shall be eaten." And he names the month they're leaving in: Abib.
cards.verse_text: And nothing leavened shall be eaten.

cards.card_text: During those seven days, leaven only has to be kept out of the people's houses.
cards.verse_text: Nothing leavened may be found among you, nor shall leaven be found anywhere within your borders.

cards.verse_text: No grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven, for you are not to burn any leaven or honey as a food offering to the LORD.

cards.verse_text: You must not eat leavened bread with it; for seven days you are to eat with it unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left the land of Egypt in haste—so that you may remember for the rest of your life the day you left the land of Egypt.
